Influence of undersized cementless hip stems on primary stability and strain distribution.

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Andreas Fottner, Matthias Woiczinski, Manuel Kistler, Christian Schröder, Tobias F Schmidutz et al. Archives of orthopaedic and trauma surgery 2017-10-01 10.1007/s00402-017-2784-x
单位: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, University Hospital of Munich (LMU), Campus Grosshadern, Marchioninistraße 15, 81377, Munich, Germany. andreas.fottner@med.uni-m
通讯: Andreas Fottner @ Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, University Hospital of Munich (LMU), Campus Gros
相关性: 该论文直接评估了髋臼柄的初期稳定性和应力遮挡，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: The paper does not include finite element analysis or patient-specific modeling; it relies solely on experimental measurements on composite bones.
动机· 评估未完全填充髋臼柄对初期稳定性和应力遮挡的影响。
方法· 在复合股骨中植入三种尺寸柄，测量微动和表面应变。
结果· 未完全填充柄微动显著增大，近端应变减少显示应力遮挡趋势。
验证· 通过体外力学测试验证，使用复合股骨和生理载荷。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical effects of undersized cementless hip stems on primary stability and stress shielding. Undersizing increases risk of aseptic loosening; this study quantifies its impact.
Method· Three consecutive stem sizes were implanted into composite femora; three-dimensional micromotions and surface strains were measured under physiologically adapted loading.
Result· Undersized stems exhibited significantly higher micromotions in all regions, with the largest at the distal tip, and proximal strain reductions indicating stress shielding tendency.
Validation· In vitro mechanical testing on composite femora with controlled stem sizes and load conditions.

A new acquisition function for Bayesian optimization based on the moment-generating function

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Hao Wang, Bas van Stein, Michael Emmerich, Thomas Bäck 2017-10-01 10.1109/smc.2017.8122656
单位: LIACS, Leiden University, Leiden, The Netherlands
通讯: Hao Wang @ LIACS, Leiden University, Leiden, The Netherlands
相关性: 该论文提出了一种基于矩生成函数的贝叶斯优化采集函数，可提高昂贵黑箱函数的优化效率，对用户研究中的代理模型优化和设计空间探索具有潜在迁移价值。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction, or biomechanical implant design.
动机· 现有采集函数未充分利用高斯过程的高阶矩信息，优化效率受限。
方法· 基于矩生成函数构造新采集函数，引入额外参数平衡探索与利用。
结果· 新采集函数在数值基准上优于广义期望改进等传统方法。
验证· 在标准数值优化问题上进行对比测试。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Existing acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization do not fully exploit higher-order moments of the Gaussian process model, limiting optimization efficiency.
Method· A novel acquisition function based on the moment-generating function of improvement is proposed, incorporating an additional parameter to control the exploration-exploitation trade-off.
Result· The proposed acquisition function outperforms traditional functions such as generalized expected improvement on numerical benchmarks.
Validation· Validation is performed on standard numerical optimization test problems.

单位: School of Control Sciences and Engineering, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian, PR China

相关性: 该论文提出了一种数据并行的贝叶斯优化方法，可加速昂贵仿真中的优化过程，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化，且未在生物力学或植入物设计领域验证。
边界: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.
动机· 贝叶斯优化推理时间随观测数立方增长，计算瓶颈严重。
方法· 提出数据并行方法，用改进几何聚类划分空间，构建多个局部代理模型。
结果· 在六个测试问题上，有限预算内收敛到良好结果，显著降低计算成本。
验证· 在标准数值测试函数上验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Bayesian optimization suffers from cubic inference time growth with observations, limiting scalability.
Method· A data-parallel Bayesian optimization is proposed using an improved geometry-motivated clustering algorithm to partition the search space and build multiple local surrogate models with an adaptive expected improvement acquisition function.
Result· The method converges to good results on six test problems under limited computational budget, achieving significant computational savings.
Validation· Validated on standard numerical benchmark functions.

Motivation· This review summarizes the current state and challenges of using stem cells in bioprinting for transplantable tissue fabrication.

Validation· As a review paper, it does not present original validation but synthesizes findings from previously published experimental studies.

Validation· Validation included photoluminescence spectroscopy, atomic force microscopy, cytotoxicity assays, and fluorescence microscopy for cellular uptake.

Motivation· To compare postoperative outcomes and mortality between cemented hemiarthroplasty and uncemented total hip arthroplasty in elderly patients with femoral neck fractures.
